name: Vice City FM
summary: Flagship electronic, synthwave, and contemporary club music radio station transmitting from Downtown Vice City, celebrating neon nightlife.
description: Vice City FM is the premier soundtrack to midnight coastal cruises along Ocean Drive. Featuring energetic modern dance tracks, throwback synth-pop remixes, and contemporary Latin club anthems, the station reflects the high-voltage atmosphere of modern Vice City night clubs like The Malibu Club.
host: DJ Fernando Martinez (guest spots) & Modern Hosts
